record.question: The rate at which the central bank borrows money from commercial banks is:
options: Marginal Cost of Funds Based Lending Rate
record.explanation: Answer C: Reverse repo rate. The reverse repo rate is the rate at which the central bank borrows from commercial banks. Reference: https://www.rbi.org.in/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: October 2025 examination (cover page); answer time-sensitive wording as of then..
